capabilities.ui: pale.web business pages (gui/), served by the public Web Host; reviewer renderer

limitations: Synthetic schedule only: no time clock, timesheets, payroll, tips, breaks or overtime pay. Estimated pay is scheduled hours times the position's rate.
One employee account at one workplace per App instance. Managers and coworkers are not accounts: what they do arrives as events.
Web pages and MCP for the employee's account; there is no manager's console.

Time is the environment's: the App has no clock event, timer or scheduler. Time-based states (a shift's phase, an expired handoff or time-off entry, a held notification) are derived from the supplied virtual time.
The workplace policy is five illustrative values, not the law of any real place. Managers are not checked against it; the account holder's shifts carry flags where a schedule breaks it.
Notifications reach Mail only through an Infra-run sender and Messaging; the App itself delivers nothing.
No attachments or media: resources are not used.
